Messages.Author: Insert Name Here
Messages.Body:
Sorry, I have another political question (can you tell I just built a
political deck?)

So, my action is Charming Lobby, and I declare/play the first and
second political action cards from my hand.

What I'm wondering is, does the second PA card (which is named at the
same time as the first PA card) contribute the value of one vote
towards the referendum which PA cards usually confer? (Or would that
be considered some form of Vote Pushing, even though Charming Lobby
allows two PA cards to be "played?")

Also, since the second PA passes automatically if the first one passes
then when I also play Voter Captivation and Bewitching Oration to
gain pool it is the first referendum that we consider when counting
votes, correct?

Thirdly, may I play two of the same PA cards (ex. KRC or whatever)
with Charming Lobby, or would that be considered a Repeat Action?

Thanks again.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
na...@site.com (Insert Name Here) wrote:
> So, my action is Charming Lobby, and I declare/play the first and
> second political action cards from my hand.

No. You play Chamring Lobby and the first political action card
from your hand (and tap the acting vampire).

> What I'm wondering is, does the second PA card (which is named at the
> same time as the first PA card) contribute the value of one vote
> towards the referendum which PA cards usually confer? (Or would that
> be considered some form of Vote Pushing, even though Charming Lobby
> allows two PA cards to be "played?")

Moot.
You get one vote from the current political action card.
If you played Charming Lobby at superior, then you also get two votes
from that.

The action will have to remain unblocked and then the referendum will
have to pass before any other actions (such as your "second" political
action) can be attempted. If the second will pass automatically,
the vote you get from the second political action card cannot be cast.

> Also, since the second PA passes automatically if the first one passes
> then when I also play Voter Captivation and Bewitching Oration to
> gain pool it is the first referendum that we consider when counting
> votes, correct?

You play them during the first political action (the Charmin Lobby action),
yes. You cannot play Bewitching Oration during a referendum that is to
pass automatically (like the second political action in this case). You
could play a Voter Captivation on a referendum that passes automatically,
but you would gain no pool or blood, since it didn't pass by any
defined amount.

> Thirdly, may I play two of the same PA cards (ex. KRC or whatever)
> with Charming Lobby, or would that be considered a Repeat Action?

(Note: "No Repeat Action" is a tournament rule. The following assumes
that that rule is in effect.)

You may play two - the second is played by a different vampire.

If "Repeat Actions" was applicable, it wouldn't matter what the
names of the political actions were - "Repeat Action" cares only
about action type (like "Political Action"), not the action
name (like "KRC"). The same minion cannot attempt two political
actions in the same turn, regardless of the nature of those two
political actions.
